concept: Where the reader is in a task of a few steps: checks for done, the loud solid for now, outlines ahead, on a groove lit up to the current step.

default_to_avoid.pattern: numbered circles in a brand colour joined by a coloured line (wizard progress) as the stepper
default_to_avoid.why_not: a brand-coloured line and circles bring a hue

derivation.consequence: one solid fill exists, the loud solid (white in dark, ink in light); a promoted action is the same solid glowing with its own light, and a pane uses one of them
derivation.form: the current step is the loud solid, the one solid on the stepper, glowing as a mark in dark

derivation.consequence: selected and pressed states change shape or add a mark (a check, a ring), never only colour
derivation.form: done is a check, now a filled number, ahead an outline, each a different shape

derivation.consequence: light falls from above, so every surface carries a rim brightest along its top edge and a soft shadow below that says where it floats, and a recess is the inverse, shaded under its top lip and lit on its bottom lip; a nested surface adds no second blur, because one sheet of glass is one layer
derivation.form: the steps sit on the etched groove of Divider, lit up to the current step

options: C a progress bar with a label
variants.reason: A carries every state by shape (P6). B brings a hue. C hides how many steps remain.

root.why: the steps in a row or a column

horizontal.why: steps side by side, the same in every theme and on every scene

vertical.why: steps one under another for long labels, the same in every theme and on every scene

step.why: one step: its mark and its text, the same in every theme and on every scene

done.why: a done step: chosen glass with a check

current.why: the current step: the loud solid, the same in every theme and on every scene

upcoming.why: an upcoming step: an outline, the same in every theme and on every scene

mark.why: the round mark that carries the state, the same in every theme and on every scene

text.why: the label and its description, the same in every theme and on every scene

label.why: the step name in the label size, the same in every theme and on every scene

description.why: a line in secondary text, the same in every theme and on every scene

sr.why: the state in words for a screen reader

@media forced-colors: active.why: forced colours outline the marks and fill the current one with the highlight
